standard-dialogue.npc: My brother was chosen as a sacrifice to Zulrah, but now the priests say you're going to sacrifice yourself first. You ruined everything!

options.text: You're angry that I've saved your brother's life?

steps.player: You're angry that I've saved your brother's life?

steps.npc: You don't get it, do you? He'd been looking forward to this for ages, and you ruined it. Now we won't even get the extra ration of sacred swamp eels.
I hope Zulrah chews you slowly when you sacrifice yourself.
I hope Zulrah chews you slowly when you sacrifice yourself.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-him-before-.npc: Have you heard? My brother has been chosen as a sacrifice to the mighty Zulrah!

options.text: How do you feel about that?

steps.player: How do you feel about that?

steps.npc: I'm jealous! I want to see Zulrah face-to-face too. Maybe next year they'll let me go.
Also, when the sacrifice is made, our mother and I will get an extra large ration of the sacred swamp eels that Zul-Onan catches. I can't wait!
